name: Sumire Sorata
source: Sumire began dating Chiaki's father during high school, and due to unforeseen circumstances, she conceives Chiaki at the early age of 17. [spoiler] She was supposedly dead, however, it is later revealed that Chiaki's grandmother feigned her death. [/spoiler]
